create_cpo_config: create a CPOConfig dataclass instance to configure CPO training with custom loss type and beta parameter
build_cpo_config_parser: build an argparse CLI from CPOConfig using HfArgumentParser for command-line training arguments
configure_cpo_loss_type: configure CPOConfig with loss_type set to sigmoid, hinge, ipo, simpo, or alphapo for different loss functions
set_cpo_regularization: set CPOConfig beta and cpo_alpha parameters to control reference model deviation and BC regularizer weight
validate_cpo_config: validate CPOConfig with __post_init__ to automatically convert alphapo loss_type to simpo with cpo_alpha=0.0
